steps.title: What the arrow means
steps.say: The green arrow shows the shift: the whole demand curve moves right, from D1 to D2. At each price, buyers now want more.

ops.text: Green arrow = demand shifts right (D1 → D2)

steps.title: Result at the old price
steps.say: At the old price P1, demand is now higher than supply, so there is a shortage. Buyers compete for the goods.
